sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would have a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would have a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would be earning more money today.
I would have a stronger career now.

options.text: I will have a better job now.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' cannot express the result of an unreal past condition. Mixed conditionals use 'would' in the result clause.

options.text: I had a better job now.
options.why_wrong: 'Had' is a past simple form and does not form a result clause that matches an unreal past condition.

options.text: I would have a better job now.
I would have had a better job last year.
options.why_wrong: The result refers to 'now', but this option refers to the past, so the time reference does not match the mixed conditional.

explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition with a present result. The if-clause uses the past perfect, and the result clause uses 'would' with a present time reference. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to use a single tense in both clauses because Portuguese conditionals are often more flexible in this respect.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado mais na escola, eu teria um emprego melhor agora.
